title: AI Agent Skills Pack: 10 evidence-first workflows for AI coding agents | Product Hunt
excerpt: Ten editable Markdown workflows for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and compatible coding agents. The pack covers code review, debugging, TDD, security, APIs, migrations, deployment, refactoring, PR shipping and incident analysis. Plain files, no executable installer or subscription. Four complete MIT-licensed companion skills are public to inspect before buying. £19 once with immediate Stripe-gated download and a 30-day refund policy.
